tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
tasks.description:
创建 Note 模型用于存储笔记。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 note.py 文件，定义 Note 类，包含字段: id (int, 主键), content (str, 笔记内容), created_at (datetime, 创建时间)。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 设置数据库迁移
tasks.description:
配置数据库迁移以支持 Note 模型。在 app/migrations/ 目录下创建迁移文件，生成 notes 表，包含 id, content, created_at 字段。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记API
tasks.description:
创建笔记的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 目录下创建 notes.py 文件，定义 POST 和 GET 路由，分别用于创建和获取笔记。确保与 Note 模型交互。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 创建笔记前端页面
tasks.description:
创建笔记管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 目录下创建 notes.html 文件，包含一个表单用于输入笔记内容，以及一个列表用于显示已保存的笔记。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

tasks.name: 实现前后端交互
tasks.description:
在前端页面中通过 JavaScript 实现与后端 API 的交互。在 static/js/ 目录下创建 notes.js 文件，使用 AJAX 或 Fetch API 调用后端的 POST 和 GET 接口，实现笔记的创建和展示功能。

API Specification (ALL TASKS MUST USE SAME API):
- POST /notes (request: {content: str}) -> {id, content, created_at}
- GET /notes -> [{id, content, created_at}]

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Note model with fields like title, content, and timestamp using an ORM such as Django or SQLAlchemy.
T1.notes: Ensure proper field validation and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Generate and apply database migrations to create the necessary tables for the Note model.
T2.notes: Use migration tools like Django Migrations or Alembic to handle schema changes.

T3.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on notes using a framework like Django REST Framework or Flask.
T3.notes: Include proper authentication and error handling mechanisms.

T4.implementation_approach: Design a frontend page using a framework like React or Vue.js to display, create, edit, and delete notes.
T4.notes: Focus on a user-friendly interface with responsive design.

T5.implementation_approach: Integrate the frontend with the backend API using HTTP requests (e.g., Axios or Fetch API).
T5.notes: Ensure proper handling of API responses and loading states for a seamless user experience.
